name: Quick Actions row (3 configurable shortcuts)
gap: home.html's own header: "CUT: greeting block, 2x2 stat grid (179px, 0 controls), quick actions, VIEW PROGRESS (a button standing in for a tab) ... calendar (338px, no tappable cells), ThrowbackCard". No quick-action row renders and nothing reads layout.quick.

name: Home header greeting, name and streak pill
gap: The time-of-day greeting and the display-name H1 are cut ("CUT: greeting block"); the avatar initial and the flame streak pill survive, the pill gated on lk_badges.

name: Configurable home block layout (order + hide)
gap: Only the four feed cards can be hidden and restored (written to lk_homeLayout.hidden); block ordering and the quick-action picker are gone, and Settings cut the layout editor outright ("Ordering Home is the designer's job, not a setting", settings.html:80-85).

name: Stats grid (4 tiles)
gap: "CUT: ... 2x2 stat grid (179px, 0 controls)". A four-tile totals grid survives on profile.html instead.

name: Weekly aggregates (training days, volume, sets, cardio, consistency label)
gap: Home prints only days trained and the consistency label; weekly volume, sets and cardio minutes moved to recap.html’s week segment, and the week starts Monday here against v6’s Sunday.

name: Proactive insight card
gap: The shipped card came back from a model; here it is arithmetic over the stored history, cached in lk_proactiveTip and labelled "Worked out from your logged sets on this device. Not a coach, and nothing was sent anywhere."

name: Throwback card
gap: home.html: "CUT: ... ThrowbackCard"; progress.html: "ThrowbackCard (25% random, unreproducible)".

name: Dynamic feed / supplement reminder / running-low / cycle reminder blocks
gap: Three of the four cards work (insight, supplements due, running low); the compounds card is wired to lk_cycles, which nothing in the build writes, so it can never render, and v6’s rotating DynamicFeed is gone.

name: Start Workout / View Progress navigation buttons
gap: Start is present and starts the session the card names (writes lk_startDay); the VIEW PROGRESS button is cut ("VIEW PROGRESS (a button standing in for a tab)") and Progress is reached only through the Climbing row.

name: Weekly Recap screen
gap: recap.html’s week segment carries sessions, sets, volume, time, records and volume-by-day, but v6’s missed-days card and streak card are not there, and the recap is a row on Home rather than a block.

name: Workout detail (edit / delete / convert to split) from Home
gap: Rows hand workout-detail the id (lk_openWorkout) and edit, delete and Repeat all work; "Convert to split" is cut — workout-detail.html:40: "REPEAT, NOT CONVERT. The original offered 'Convert to split', which makes a whole training split out of one day. That is a bigger claim than one session supports".

name: Auto-add due staples on Home mount
"Set up your first split" empty-state card
Goals list (active + completed)
gap: One flat list in a sheet: no active/completed split, no COMPLETED section, no per-goal tap target and no empty state.

name: Create / edit a goal
gap: Create works and persists to lk_goals with type, start, target, unit and date; there is no edit and no delete.

name: Goal detail view (ring, start/current/target, deadline, notes)
gap: No goal detail view at all: no ring, no start/current/target tiles, no deadline chip, no notes and no Mark Complete — only a name, a percentage and a bar in the list.

name: AI goal progress analysis
gap: No analyse control anywhere on the goals surface.

name: Body Fat Log (manual entry, method chips, history)
AI body fat estimate
gap: No body-fat estimate control; the only consent-gated model path on the screen is the photo analyse flow.

name: Beta activity telemetry from Goals
gap: There is no beta telemetry layer in the build, so no goal or body-fat event is logged.

name: Floating voice command button (capture)
gap: home.html: "CUT: ... the voice FAB (second accent fill, and it intercepted pointer events over the last block)"; settings.html: "Cycle logging and Microphone flags. ... the voice button also intercepted pointer events on two other screens."

name: Draggable/snapping voice button physics
gap: The button the physics belonged to is cut: "the voice FAB (second accent fill, and it intercepted pointer events over the last block)".

name: Voice command confirmation sheet
gap: Cut with the button: "CUT: ... the voice FAB".

name: Voice action execution (six intents)
gap: Cut with the button: "CUT: ... the voice FAB".

name: Voice enable/disable toggle
gap: settings.html: "Cycle logging and Microphone flags. A toggle that adds or removes a whole tab is build configuration wearing a preference’s clothes; the voice button also intercepted pointer events on two other screens."

name: First-run tutorial / onboarding walkthrough
gap: tutorial.html is built, animates, is skippable from the first frame and writes lk_tutorialSeen on both skip and finish — but nothing reads that gate, so it never appears on a first run; the only route in is Settings > How LOCKED works.

name: App root component & global state
gap: There is no root component holding global state: each screen reads and writes LKStore independently and re-reads on lk:enter. The persistence, the seed fallback, the unit source and the onboarding gate are all served, but the write-through setters and the single in-memory profile/useKg/splits/history the v6 root owned do not exist.

name: Bottom navigation bar (`Nav`)
gap: Every screen carries its own five-tab bar with aria-current and scroll-minimise, but it is duplicated markup per file rather than one Nav: no ResizeObserver, no --lk-nav-h published, and the active tab is hard-coded in each screen instead of derived.

name: In-progress workout banner
gap: Replaced by the session shelf (session.js) mounted above the tab bar on fifteen screens, naming the session, counting sets, deriving elapsed and marking a stale session. It carries no rest countdown, and it sits at the bottom rather than as a fixed top banner, so nothing publishes --lk-top-off.

name: Resume-workout dialog
gap: There is no on-mount resume dialog. The shelf is the resume affordance and a stale session gets Resume plus a real Finish, but the two-tap armed "Start Fresh / Discard workout?" that cleared the four active-workout keys has no equivalent outside the workout log.

name: Notification / deep-link routing
gap: No ?open= handling, no lockedPushOpen listener and no deep-link routing of any kind. onboarding.html’s ?open= only picks which onboarding pane to show.

name: Workout lifecycle in the root
gap: The lifecycle works end to end (start from Home or Train, log, Finish, Review, Save, lk_history) but it is owned by workout-log.html, review.html and session.js rather than a root; there is no post-save sync and no activity log.

name: Mount, ErrorBoundary and CDN fallback
gap: The demo wraps each screen’s boot in a try/catch and renders a per-screen error host with a retry; there is no whole-app "Failed to Load App" panel, no boundary at all when a screen is opened standalone, and the CDN fallback has no counterpart because there is no CDN.

name: Shell chrome (status-bar scrim, toasts, voice button)
gap: The status-bar treatment and the toast pattern exist (tokens.css, components.css .toast) and the shelf replaces the banner, but there is no shared shell: each screen builds its own toast markup, and the voice button is cut.

name: Supabase client bootstrap
gap: No Supabase client, no URL, no anon key and no auth library anywhere in the build.

name: Sign up
gap: The whole local half is built — email validation, an 8-character minimum, a common-password list, a live strength meter that leads with length, a busy state and a duplicate-email path (taken@example.com) — but the success path walks straight into setup without saying no account was created; only the Terms sheet says so.

name: Sign in
gap: Validation, reveal, busy state, wrong-password and network-failure states are all built and honest; the password locked1234 is the local stand-in for a server.

name: Sign out
gap: Settings has Sign out behind a confirm dialog that names the consequence, flips the account card to signed-out and writes lk_guestMode; nothing is revoked because there is no session.

name: Password change
gap: Every rule checkable on the device is checked (current required, 8-character minimum, not the same as the current one, the two new fields must match) and the sheet says "nothing is saved, nothing is sent, and your password is unchanged".

name: Password reset
gap: Forgot password validates the address actually typed and then says "Resetting a password needs a server ... there is no account system behind this build, so nothing can be sent to <address>".

name: Resend confirmation
gap: There is no confirm-email pane at all, so no resend control and no pending-email state.

name: Session restore on load
gap: Boot reads lk_onboarded, lk_profile, lk_splits and lk_history to decide whether to show onboarding, which is the local half; the "Checking for a saved session" screen exists only as a dev-switcher variant and nothing runs on load.

name: Guest / anonymous mode
gap: The guest warning screen is built in full (four named costs, a storage-blocked error state, a busy state) and Settings and Profile both read lk_guestMode, but the guest path never writes it — after Continue as guest, localStorage.lk_guestMode is still null and Settings opens signed-in.

name: Supabase `profiles` table read (App root)
gap: No profiles table and no remote profile read; lk_profile is the only source.

name: Auth overlay UI
gap: Replaced by real onboarding screens rather than a string-HTML overlay: labelled fields, a reveal toggle, a live strength meter, inline errors and banners, and a focus-managed Terms sheet — accessibility is better than v6’s. Missing: the confirm mode, the trial note, the paywall-adjacent copy, and it is a full screen rather than an overlay over the app.

name: `getToken` / `headers` / `authHeaders`
gap: There is no network layer, so no token accessor and no header builder.

name: Account deletion
gap: The dialog says plainly "There is no account server in this build, so nothing can be deleted from one. What this does do is sign you out and erase everything LOCKED has stored on this phone" and then actually does that through LKStore.reset().

name: Toast
gap: A toast exists and works on every screen that needs one, with a dismiss and an optional action, but each screen builds its own markup from the shared .toast classes; there is no helper in chrome.js, so the behaviour can drift screen to screen.

name: Bidirectional cloud sync
gap: The whole visible half is built and fail-closed: busy, failed and idle states, a spinner and aria-busy, a live-region announcement, "Never synced. This build has no server to sync with." and a completion toast of "Not in this build. Nothing has left this device." No timestamp is written for a sync that did not happen.

name: The sync key set & write timestamping
gap: There is no SYNC_KEYS set and no __lk_ts__ write timestamping; LKStore records no per-key modification time, so nothing could be merged even if a server appeared.

name: Cycle-tracking opt-in sync
gap: No lk_mcCloudSync flag and no opt-in path; lk_cycle only gates whether the cycle surface is shown.

name: Beta data sync (`/beta-sync`) — separate, legacy channel
gap: No beta channel of any kind.

name: Deploy-version check / cache bust
gap: Settings’ Force refresh clears Cache Storage and reloads, on demand and honestly labelled; there is no /app-version fetch, no lk_deployVersion and no automatic check on load.

name: The paywall sheet
gap: Nothing about Pro, pricing or a paywall exists anywhere in the build.

name: Entitlement fetch & the `can()` gate
gap: No entitlement fetch and no can() gate; every feature is open.

name: Actual runtime gating — server-side 429 / `gated`
gap: No runtime gating; there is no network call to be gated.

name: Trial banner
gap: No trial banner and no trial state.

name: Beta code system
gap: settings.html: "The beta code card. Beta enrolment is not a preference, it shipped to every user, it had no busy state, and it granted access when the network failed. Unfinished and wrong when it failed."

name: Silent beta
gap: No beta layer, so no silent-beta id list.

name: Activity & AI logging
gap: No activity or AI logging anywhere; nothing appends to lk_betaLog or lk_betaAILog.

name: Beta admin panel
gap: No admin panel and no route to one.

name: Storage layer (`ld` / `sd` / `lkStorageUsage`)
gap: LKStore replaces ld/sd with a guarded, seeded, tombstoned store and Settings measures real usage from LKStore.dump() against 5 MB with an amber warning at 80%. Missing: quota-error classification, the one-shot "Storage is full" toast and the lockedStorageFull event — a write that fails is kept in memory and reported to the caller as false, but no screen tells the person.

name: Schema migrations
gap: No migration layer and no migration flags; the generated fixtures are already in the current shape, so nothing upgrades an older store.

name: Onboarding gate (when the flow appears / how it is skipped)
Invite / beta code entry + Beta Tester Agreement (step 1)
gap: The build removed beta enrolment wholesale — settings.html: "The beta code card. Beta enrolment is not a preference, it shipped to every user, it had no busy state, and it granted access when the network failed. Unfinished and wrong when it failed." There is no code field on the welcome screen and no Beta Tester Agreement.

name: Step 4 — AI coach chat interview (auto-kickoff)
gap: There is no chat interview: steps 4 to 6 are three more choice questions (experience, days per week, goal). Nothing calls a model.

name: Step 4 — Answering questions (3-question loop, counter, send)
gap: No composer, no answer counter, no send and no three-answer loop.

name: Worker AI endpoint (`callWorker`) — the fetch at ~33857
gap: No worker fetch and no network call of any kind in onboarding.

name: Chat system prompt (`getChatSys`)
gap: No chat system prompt, because there is no chat.

name: Program generation + parsing (`getGenSys`, `tryParseProg`)
gap: No model call and no ###PROGRAM_START### parsing. In its place a deterministic PLANS table builds a real multi-day split from the days answer, using ids verified against tests/fixtures/exercise-db.json, and writes it to lk_splits — a complete local half, but the program is chosen, not generated, and the screen does not say which.

name: Program preview card (in-chat)
gap: The overview screen previews the plan that was just written — name, split, rep range, how loads climb, units, and the first day’s exercises by name and group — but it is a full screen at the end, not a card inside a chat, and it shows only day 1 rather than a row per split.

name: FOODS database
gap: The local food table is 8 composite meals with aliases, part lists and barcodes against v6’s ~110 per-100g foods, so most of what a person eats is not in it and USDA lookup is deferred (14-signoff/WORKER-USDA-KEY.md).

name: Service worker registration
gap: No service worker file and no registration; Settings states the consequence at the point of use — "Sending one later, when the app is closed, needs a service worker, and this build has none: nothing here is scheduled."

name: PWA manifest and iOS install metadata
gap: No manifest link and no apple-mobile-web-app-* metadata on any of the eighteen screens; grep for rel="manifest" and apple-mobile returns nothing.

name: Install prompt (`beforeinstallprompt`)
gap: No beforeinstallprompt handling and no install affordance. v6 had none either, so this is a gap against the spec rather than a regression.

name: Deploy-version check and cache bust
gap: Only the manual half: Settings’ Force refresh clears Cache Storage and reloads. There is no version fetch on load, no lk_deployVersion and no automatic bust.

name: Zoom lock
gap: No gesturestart/gesturechange/gestureend preventDefault and the viewport permits scaling; only touch-action: manipulation on buttons, which handles double-tap but not pinch.

name: Push notification module (`window.LOCKEDPush`)
gap: There is no LOCKEDPush module and no subscription. The permission request is real, the test send is a real notification from the page, and the card says which half is missing.

name: Notification preferences and scheduling
gap: The six preferences are real, stored in lk_notifPrefs and survive a reload; nothing is scheduled and the card says so in its own voice.

name: Service worker → app messaging and push deep links
gap: No service worker, so no message channel and no push deep links.

name: Boot self-heal for push subscriptions
gap: No push subscription to self-heal.

name: `ErrorBoundary` — whole-app crash screen
gap: The demo catches a screen’s boot throw and renders a per-screen error host with a retry, and Home, Progress and Profile each have their own error state; there is no whole-app crash screen, and a screen opened standalone has no boundary at all.

name: Event listeners at a system level (54 `addEventListener` calls)
gap: The shared listeners live in chrome.js, store.js, session.js and theme.js (scroll, resize, storage, visibilitychange, click capture, lk:enter, lk:handoff) and they work, but there is no visualViewport listener and no gesture listener, and the feature’s own spec is blank so parity cannot be measured exactly.

name: Timers at a system level
gap: Timers exist and are disciplined where it matters — the shelf ticks once a second and repaints only when its key changes, and it stops repainting a hidden tab — but there is no system-level timer registry and the feature’s own spec is blank, so parity cannot be judged.

name: Beta data collection and sync (touched by onboarding)
gap: No beta collection and no beta sync.

name: Style profile (theme) switching
gap: theme.js gives Dark, Light and Match device, applied pre-paint from lk_theme and offered as a Settings row, so it survives a reload and themes every screen. v6’s slate, navy and midnight profiles are gone and nothing rewrites the theme-color meta, because no screen carries one.

name: Text size (Dynamic Type)
gap: settings.html: "Text size. iOS ships Dynamic Type as a system setting. A second, app-only text size duplicates it, disagrees with it, and was filed under DATA & SYNC." Every type token is rem (tokens.css:41-51), so the system setting scales the whole app and tests/dynamic-type.mjs checks it at AX5.

name: Storage-full recovery
gap: store.js probes writability once and falls back to an in-memory store, Settings measures usage against 5 MB and warns in amber past 80%, and a photo that cannot be saved says so. Missing: quota-error classification, the one-shot "Storage is full" toast and the lockedStorageFull event, so an ordinary write that fails is invisible to the person.

name: Error recovery screens
gap: Per-screen error states with one clear recovery action exist on Home, Progress, Profile and Settings, and the demo contains a screen crash; there is no whole-app recovery screen and no boundary when a screen is opened on its own.

name: Weight log & refeed trigger
gap: The weight log upserts one entry per day with per-entry deltas and a weekly rate, and the refeed fires only on a cut after three consecutive all-time lows, capped at estimated maintenance. The dismissal is held in page memory rather than lk_refeedDismissed, so v6’s five-day suppression does not survive a reload.

name: Keyboard-aware chrome & zoom lock
gap: No visualViewport listener, no lk-kb-open class and no nav hiding while the keyboard is up; no gesturestart/change/end preventDefault either. Only touch-action: manipulation on buttons survives.

name: Deploy-version cache bust
gap: Manual only: Force refresh clears Cache Storage and reloads. No /app-version fetch, no lk_deployVersion comparison and no automatic bust on load.

name: Progress throwback
gap: progress.html: "ThrowbackCard (25% random, unreproducible)"; home.html: "CUT: ... ThrowbackCard".
